name: io.github.pad01g/proxy-shopping
title: proxy-shopping: buy anywhere with crypto through a proxy shopper
description: Buy at cash-only or unsupported shops with BTC via a proxy shopper and 2-of-3 escrow, or earn as one

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Volume that keeps this agent's key (a BIP39 mnemonic, created on first run) and its orders across runs

environmentVariables.name: PS_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: ps-main (the public network: Nostr relays, BTC signet) or lab (the local docker compose lab)

environmentVariables.name: PS_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory of the mnemonic and order state inside the container; mount a volume there

environmentVariables.name: PS_LAB_URL
environmentVariables.description: Lab only: the lab demo server as seen from the container

environmentVariables.name: PS_CONFIG_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional URL of a web-app config.json (relays, coordinators, chains) that overrides the network preset
